task: Masked Mandarin nominal observed-form classification; weak labels, not indefinite gold
checkpoint: final epoch; no test checkpoint selection
threshold_grid: 0.005 to 0.995 inclusive, step 0.005; maximize dev macro-F1, then balanced accuracy, then closest to 0.5
serving_selection: highest dev macro-F1 among neural models with fixed primary seed 1729; other seeds only sensitivity analysis
lexical_baseline: train-only character TF-IDF 1-3grams, min_df=2, max_features=20000; logistic regression C=1, balanced class weights
test_policy: same original 913-row test benchmark; already examined in previous phase, not a new untouched external validation
bootstrap: 500 resamples of test sentences with replacement, seed 1729; 95 percent descriptive interval
